prompt: The assistant lists all briefing attendees in a separate register. The new form is signed only after a technician takes a copy of the revised instructions. Signing it says nothing about whether the technician has read the instructions or agreed to a change. A signature on that form _____ receipt of the revised instructions.
promptZh: 助理另外用簽到簿記下所有參加說明會的人。技術人員必須先拿到一份修訂指引，才在新表單上簽名。簽名並不代表他已閱讀指引或同意變更。這張表單上的簽名_____。

options.zh: 授權技術人員領取修訂指引
options.whyZh: 簽名發生在拿到指引之後，用來留存紀錄，不是給予領取權限。
領取已經發生；簽名不是說將來才會收到。

options.zh: 是領取指引的先決條件
options.whyZh: 修訂指引先交到技術人員手上，再以簽名記錄；簽名不是領取的先決條件。

options.zh: 確認他已收到修訂指引
options.whyZh: 簽名只確認技術人員已收到指引，不等於閱讀、同意修改或出席證明。

explanationZh: 簽名只確認技術人員已收到指引，不等於閱讀、同意修改或出席證明。
evidence: The assistant lists all briefing attendees in a separate register. / The new form is signed only after a technician takes a copy of the revised instructions. / Signing it says nothing about whether the technician has read the instructions or agreed to a change.

vocabulary.note: attendee 指實際參加會議或活動的人；briefing 說明活動類型。
